tasks.gr12-vat-concepts-control-t3: Topic: VAT Concepts and Control. Cover output VAT, input VAT, VAT-inclusive and VAT-exclusive calculations, the VAT control account, supporting documents, and ethical compliance with SARS rules. Ask Grade 12 learners to calculate VAT, determine whether SARS is owed or owes a refund, or evaluate a VAT compliance scenario.
tasks.gr12-budgeting-projected-income-t3: Topic: Budgeting and Projected Income. Cover projected income statements, budgeting assumptions, gross profit, expense projections, debtor collection patterns, and cash planning. Ask Grade 12 learners to calculate a projected figure, explain the impact of a changed assumption, or interpret a cash shortfall or profit forecast.
tasks.gr12-trial-exam-revision-t3: Topic: Trial Examination Revision. Integrate companies, cash flow, interpretation, inventory, fixed assets, manufacturing, reconciliations, VAT and budgeting. Ask Grade 12 learners mixed revision questions that require linking topics, correcting common errors, or justifying conclusions with accounting evidence.
